subject: rotp
title: ROTP.------INFO.DS.
description: Chart on book p. 406 (JR-28). ROTP (responsibility of the position) is the subject; INFO-DS (information dissemination) is the partner. From the subject: MY-INFO, TR (transformation) and POL-P (political policies). From MY-INFO: MOT-DY. From MOT-DY: MT-DEVF (multiple diversification). From TR: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From LK-IMP: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From POL-P: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From RT-DY: INFO-FR (information forum). From INFO-FR: JR-DY (journalism dynamics).
